tools.name: rtk
tools.notes: Token-optimized command proxy. Router rewrites grep/find/cat through rtk; rtk rewrite exit-code protocol (0/1/2/3) is version-coupled (unchanged through 1.0.1 — re-verified against rtk master src/hooks/rewrite_cmd.rs, which still renders Allow→0, Deny→2, Ask→3, Default→3, Defer→1 with the #1155 least-privilege tests intact). Since 0.49.0: -l is GNU --files-with-matches under rtk grep (completing 0.47.0's -t/-m passthrough), rewrite handles safe pipes, peels process wrapper prefixes, and passes sudo commands through. Since 0.50.0: head/tail rewrites are faithful to the native commands (head window no longer reads past the lines requested, non-UTF-8 windows preserved), git/grep/dotnet/golangci arg parsing migrated onto a shared arg_tokenizer, and rtk gain reports weighted savings rates with signed saved-token sums (negative totals are possible; the metrics.ts negative-delta/clawback branch already handles them). The new rtk ast-grep output filter is search-shaped like rtk grep and stays pass-through — it is not in the blocked cat/read/smart code-reading family. 1.0.0 (the 1.x milestone: pipelines in the CLI, hook gate, rtk llm-proxy; engine/plugin/text crate split; rtk-proxy daemon) breaks per its own BREAKING CHANGES block: rtk proxy is now rtk bypass (old name stays an alias), --ultra-compact is removed, rtk gain excludes oversized outputs from its headline rate, and the default binary's licence changes (an Apache-2.0 rtk-oss edition ships alongside) — none of the renamed/removed surfaces are in rig's call surface (no rtk proxy/rtk bypass/--ultra-compact anywhere in src/, templates/, or tests/). The in-process `rtk hook <agent>` path still exists in 1.x, so the rtk-global-hook marker (\brtk hook\b in ~/.claude/settings.json) still detects a 1.x `rtk init -g`. 1.0.1 fixes gain only suggesting `rtk pipeline share` where the command exists (#4557) and llm-proxy honouring RTK_PROXY_BIND (#4556) — rig consumes neither. metrics.ts parses only summary.total_saved from `rtk gain --format json` and warns on schema drift, so the headline-rate semantics change is display-side; re-check the JSON shape against a real 1.0.1 binary in the local-verification step (the contract test self-skips where no rtk binary exists).

tools.name: graphify
tools.notes: Knowledge graph builder. PyPI package name is graphifyy; repo moved to Graphify-Labs (safishamsi redirects); version-warns outside tested range. 0.9.53 writes no .rebuild.lock; its shrink guard keeps a partial build from overwriting graph.json, and since 0.9.53 (#3203) an unverified per-source shrink arms the guard and re-queues the source on the next run — a first run can legitimately return a smaller graph that a later run completes. Since 0.9.65 (#3697/#3695) the eviction pass re-checks the kept set, so a moved-file/symlink layout can no longer deadlock the shrink guard into refusing every update. Since 0.9.66 graph.json is deterministic across runs (PYTHONHASHSEED pinned via a one-time re-exec; the re-exec exit-code races that path introduced were fixed through 0.9.67/0.9.68), and 0.9.68 preserves cross-file imports/calls/uses edges into unchanged files on incremental updates (node/edge counts shift upward on multilingual repos — a /savings display change, not a parse change). 0.9.70 ships security fixes — GHSA-pcc4-rvhr-2pr8 (the Fortran cpp step no longer reads arbitrary host files via absolute/traversing #include during preprocessing; contents could previously be inlined into graph.json/GRAPH_REPORT.md and the LLM context), --watch snippet shell injection closed, Terraform secret redaction widened — plus five new language extractors in 0.9.66 (COBOL, VB.NET, R, Solidity, Erlang). The GRAPH_REPORT.md summary/extraction layout that metrics.ts regex-matches is unchanged through 0.9.76 (nothing in 0.9.72-0.9.76 touches the summary or Extraction lines; 0.9.72's community-listing filter is a different section). Since 0.9.72 (five releases in one week through 0.9.76): additive extractor/resolution coverage plus one security fix — no CLI, graph.json layout, or MCP protocol change is announced. Rig-visible effects are numeric, the same class already recorded for 0.9.68: enum members became case_of nodes (0.9.73, Rust/Zig/C++/Scala 3) and intra-class self/this/super calls now bind across Python/JS/TS/Swift/Ruby (0.9.75), so node/edge counts shift upward; Rust prelude types no longer accumulate spurious in-degree, so god_nodes returns cleaner cores (a data-quality change to what rig's scout surfaces, not a parse change); cross-repo resolver confidence snapped to the canonical INFERRED rubric (0.9.76, label-only) shifts the EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS percentages session start reports. shortest_path (mcp__graphify__shortest_path, listed by rig's scout) resolves exact endpoints and refuses ambiguous ones (0.9.76), and routes through a contains edge back out to a symbol's file so cross-file paths through shared symbols are found instead of reporting none (0.9.75). 0.9.76 also stops walking JSON Schema files as config manifests, feeds only Svelte script blocks to the AST pass, and records calls edges to plainly-imported external Python modules (fail-closed). rig's only build trigger is graphify update (ensureGraphBuilt), so graphify extract's new dedup-shrink refusal has no rig path, and 0.9.72's auto-refresh touches only graphify's own installed skill sidecars, never rig's .claude/skills/. Security: graphify hook install refuses a core.hooksPath resolving outside the repository (CWE-22, graphify#3919) — no rig code path, rig never installs git hooks.

tools.name: headroom
tools.notes: Context-compression proxy. Repo moved to headroomlabs-ai (chopratejas redirects); detected via headroom-init-claude hook marker or localhost ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL; /savings reads `headroom perf --format json`. Since 0.38.0: zip-bomb DoS bound and per-port proxy logs. 0.39.0 reworked the savings surface (new-input basis beside whole-wire, exact cache-read cost in rollups, lifetime output spend, negative savings reported instead of floored at zero) and added protect_messages plus TPM limiting; captureHeadroomStats gates on finite numbers, so signed tokens_saved passes and renders. 0.39.1 fixes 0.39.0's TPM limiter refusing large-context requests (never pin 0.39.0). Since 0.40.0: upstream-breaking twice — HEADROOM_LICENSE env plus opt-in usage reporting (#3857) and the crewai extra dropped (#3870) — neither touches a rig seam; detection (hook marker or localhost ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) is unchanged. #3320 gives savings metrics one canonical home and #3632/#3821/#3128 fix savings accounting, so the four perf JSON fields captureHeadroomStats gates on need live re-verification on 0.40.0; drift fails safe via the strict schema gate's 'unexpected schema' warning. Wrap-lifecycle hardening (#3202/#3799/#3201/#1358/#3855) improves the trial path rig's README recommends.

tools.name: superpowers
tools.notes: Base skills framework (required). Detected via ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json; every chain skill wraps a superpowers:* skill. 6.3.0 SDD task-batching (#2078) is deliberately declined in sdd+ (per-task dispatch is load-bearing); the Spec: pointer (#2086) is emitted by plan+; brainstorming ceremony scaling (#2063) does not scale down the brain+ overlay. 6.4.1's TDD full-suite-during-the-loop rule (#2110) is deliberately declined for the tdd+/sdd+ loop — the full-suite green gate stays in verify+ where the zero-defect hook blocks (divergence documented in the tdd+ template); its plan handoff (#2258/#2318) is answered Subagent-driven in sdd+, with tdd+ as rig's native/inline peer; plan+ emits the Review Focus section (#2319) and spec-reviewer verifies its pinning tests. 6.4.2 reworks writing-plans as decisions-not-transcript (#2333: a test step names the test and its assertions, a code step the exact signature/file/spec values, a verification step the command and passing output) and adds a proportion self-review (a plan several times longer than its spec is a transcript); the plan+ overlay is already decision-level against "What a Step Contains" — no trim needed — but its mandatory sections (Constitutional Rules, Mock Policy, Spec: pointer, independence contract, Review Focus) can trip the proportion check on a small spec (model-driven; eval surface). 6.4.2 removed plan-document-reviewer-prompt.md (never referenced by rig) and swapped repo CLAUDE.md for AGENTS.md (detection reads installed_plugins.json, unaffected). All pinned 6.4.1 behaviors — #2110 full-suite rule, #2258/#2318 handoff, #2319 Review Focus — are still present in the 6.4.2 skill texts, so every documented divergence stands.
